recomputed_not_copied: All values recomputed from the parquets on the date below. They agree with notes/artifact-clip-0.94.md (35.17% atom, 55.5% boundary) and, for the fixed build, with data/frozen_poster_numbers.json (56.86% boundary, 17.48% violations).
bus_convention: atom_top_buses gives both the pandapower 0-based bus_index and the IEEE 1-based ieee_bus (= index + 1).
byte_reproducible_evidence: Ran twice on 2026-09-21 with the argv above; md5 identical.
no_new_solves: No AC solve, dataset build, or model fit was run; statistics over existing parquets only.
